<div class="card-body">
'''Tusken Raider''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タスケン・レイダー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊タスケン・レイダーの合計戦闘力は、その場所にいる人数の合計で変化する。合計戦闘力は、１名であれば１、２名＝３、３名＝６、４名＝１０となる。１つの位置カードには４名までしかおけない。タトゥイーンにしか配備できないが、そこからなら好きなところへ移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-196o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">別称サンド・ピープル。ゴーグルと呼吸マスクを顔に装着している。バンサに騎乗し、ガッフィの杖を振るう。好戦的で、砂漠で生活する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tusken Raider.

'''Card text:''' Tusken Raiders' total power depends on how many are at that site. Total power is 1 for one, 3 for two, 6 for three, and 10 for four. No more than four may be at a site. Deploy only to Tatooine. From there, they may move anywhere.

'''Lore:''' Also known as Sand People. They wear goggles and breathing masks, ride banthas, and wield gaffi sticks. They are warlike and live in the desert.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tusken Raider]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
